g.text: The 42 most connected parliamentarians, by boards shared. The ring is ordered by chamber — deputies on one arc, senators on the other — so a cross-chamber tie crosses the middle. Edge width is the number of
shared boards; node area is the total. An edge does not say the two men sat in the same year: of 404 pairs, 73 have verifiably overlapping terms and 277 are undetermined.
